name: reconcile-ey-content-removal
body: source: parked-template-catalogue said the EY templates/theme/fonts/logos migrate to an in-repo example library; embedded-assets and the global constraints called reveal.js + page shells "engine"; inconsistency: user decided EY content is deleted entirely and the shells are core; resolution: parked-template-catalogue marked RESOLVED (removed); embedded-assets (requirement + component), global.constraint.no-embedded-template-assets and global.constraint.go-static-embedded-binary reworded to "core", unbranded, and no in-repo EY library; brand-owner stakeholder (formerly ey-brand-owner), template-author user and person no longer say templates are compiled into the binary. [with user]
